rationale: John brings hands-on cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise from Cloudfitters and deep conviction around agentic AI, while Manish is a Staff ML Engineer at Palo Alto Networks with proven experience shipping AI-powered systems at Meta—together they can explore how production ML infrastructure and autonomous AI systems are reshaping cybersecurity. Both operate at the intersection of ML infrastructure and security domains, where John's operations perspective and cloud platform depth complement Manish's deep learning and systems expertise.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Manish Kumar Keshri — you both work at the intersection of ML infrastructure and cybersecurity, and your complementary backgrounds in cloud operations and production ML systems could spark a valuable conversation on how agentic AI is reshaping security infrastructure.
